name: Toyota Toyo Limiter v2 — Source-Verified BIN Inspector
description: Read-only source-derived inspection of Toyota BIN files from the owner's Toyo Limiter v2.1.0 calibration profiles. Reports raw speed bytes, RPM observations, CUT-off signature evidence, exact offsets and SHA-256; refuses ambiguous profile matches and does not calculate checksums. Headless; no licensing, tokens, users, private stock vault or external network access.

capabilities.description: Read Toyota ECU BIN metadata with source-derived profiles; return observed speed bytes, RPM and cut-off evidence, offsets, SHA-256 and uncertainty. Never patches or flashes.
List Toyo Limiter v2 calibration profile identifiers and expected BIN sizes from the authenticated source-derived profile manifest; no data is modified.
